create_CountingIterator: create a CountingIterator wrapper that tracks iteration count and supports skip and take methods
build_EpochBatchIterator: build an EpochBatchIterator for multi-epoch dataset iteration with sharding, shuffling, and state serialization
create_GroupedIterator: create a GroupedIterator that chunks an iterable into fixed-size groups with optional remainder skipping
build_ShardedIterator: build a ShardedIterator to split an iterable into N shards for distributed data loading
create_BufferedIterator: create a BufferedIterator with a background consumer thread to prefetch batches and reduce data loading bottlenecks
